content: SQLite in Docker: mount the exact directory containing the DB file (wrong path = silent data loss on recreate). Prefer named volume or carefully managed bind mount. WAL requires shared-memory coherence — unsafe on network/virtiofs/Docker Desktop host bind mounts; can corrupt DB (sqlite.org WAL docs; OpenClaw/Sonarr issues). Mount dir must be writable for -wal/-shm/journal sidecars. Single writer only.
